hunter-03: proposed 3 real photos from otzovik reviews. Rejected on purpose: otzovik photos of the OLD label design (cream top band, Cyrillic АGORA КРЫМ / САПЕРАВИ) e.g. review_9740489, review_7710845, review_5109425 - same wine, different label from the catalogue render; and review_11581472 which shows SAPERAVI RED DRY WINE (2018) - the dry version, not this semi-sweet one.

hunter-03: 3 proposals. Two of them are group photos of the Mountain Eagle line; the reviewer should check whether a lineup shot is wanted in the set. All proposals are 2021 bottles while the catalogue render is 2022; the label design is identical apart from the year. Marker against the sibling grape Marselan: this label is near-black, Marselan is grey.

hunter-01: no real-world photo found. This is the 0.25 l can, and coverage is very thin. Searched otzovik (via VPS), irecommend CDN, Bing images (6 variants incl. the photo-only filter) and WebSearch for Абрау Физз / Abrau Fizz / жестяная банка. Results are dominated by the Abrau Light can line and by Abrau Vinonade, which are different products. No user photo of an ABRAU Fizz can was found.

hunter-09: the three photos that were already in this slug (01, 02, 03) are Blanc de Talu 2019, a different wine of the same producer, not Uroki Frantsuzskogo Sauvignon. The label has three generations: current = both the producer line and the grape line in Cyrillic (SHATO de TALYU / sovinon), earlier = Latin CHATEAU de TALU with Cyrillic Sovinon, earliest = Latin CHATEAU de TALU with Latin SAUVIGNON. Not proposed, because it is a close-up of the label alone: the Vivino user photo https://images.vivino.com/thumbs/tahjkNOtQ0qHTzxJlREzjA_375x500.jpg from https://www.vivino.com/en/chateau-de-talu-uroki-phrantsuzskogo-french-lessons-sauvignon/w/11991283 (Latin SAUVIGNON generation). otzovik has reviews only for the Chardonnay and Krasnostop siblings of this line.

hunter-09: trap for the reviewer. Three bottles of this line look almost the same. Base (this slug): man in a top hat CLIMBING the ladder, grape line reads only Kaberne Fran. Reserve (slug ...-rezerv-...-146): man SITTING on a cloud, second line Rezerv. Premium (not in the test set): man climbing the ladder like the base, second line Premium. Only that one small line separates the base from the Premium. No user photo of the base bottle was found; all three proposals are shop studio shots.

hunter-09: warning about a near neighbour. Chateau de Talu also sells a Cabernet Franc Reserve with a completely different white label showing the chateau above engraved sea waves (CABERNET FRANC / RESERVE / GELENDZHIK, or the Cyrillic KABERNE FRAN / REZERV), for example https://krasnostop.ru/images/detailed/6/tl-cbrnt-fnc-rsrv.jpg and https://static.decanter.ru/upload/images/443252/443252-vino-chateau-de-talu-cabernet-franc-reserve-2020-0-75-l-f.jpg . It may be the pre-Yuzhnaya-Vertikal generation of this same wine, or a separate Reserve line. I could not settle it, so I did not propose those as variants. Also not proposed, because it is a close-up of the label alone: the Vivino user photo https://images.vivino.com/thumbs/pxpa4ko5Rpm1e3lZH5v-9w_375x500.jpg from https://www.vivino.com/en/chateau-de-talu-iuzhnaia-vertikal-kaberne-fran-rezerv-south-vertical-cabernet-franc-reserve/w/12682659 - it does show the correct Yuzhnaya Vertikal Reserve label.

hunter-09: the four photos that were already in this slug (01-04) all show the STILL wine Chateau Tamagne SELECT BLANC 2021, Chardonnay - Sauvignon Blanc, in a burgundy bottle with a screwcap. That is not this sparkling Select Blanc Brut. They should be labelled negative. The catalogue bottle itself is the 0.2 l piccolo with pewter foil; the 0.75 l bottles I proposed carry the same white label with the square-in-square logo but gold foil.

hunter-10: WARNING for the reviewer - the existing photos 01-04 are the regular Chateau Tamagne Cabernet line (cream label with the round blue seal, 'ROUGE SEC CABERNET'), not the Signature line. The Signature label is white with the red 'Signature' script, 'BARREL-AGED CABERNET', the year and the print run 'тираж 28 125 бутылок'.
hunter-10: the Signature line differs only in one word and in the print run: CABERNET / тираж 28 125, SAPERAVI / тираж 33 750, STEEL-AGED CHARDONNAY / тираж 30 712. Read that line before you label.

hunter-10: the catalogue bottle is the 2023 with print run 'тираж 30 712 бутылок'. A 2022 Signature Chardonnay also exists with the same design and 'тираж 34 000 бутылок'; it has no slug of its own in the catalogue. All three proposals show the 2023.

hunter-11 trap warning: this wine has a Rose sibling with an almost identical label. The Rose prints Pinot Gris in RED script and adds the word Rose. Two candidates I found and rejected were the Rose: otzovik review_13759651 and the Roskachestvo photo rskrf.ru/upload/iblock/914/3lstfg5u42ttzopw86ce1qmvaevm1970.jpg.

hunter-11: only one user photo of this wine exists on the open web (the Vivino label photo). otzovik has no product page for the Reserve, irecommend has none, and Yandex images returns only shop cards. The other two proposals are shop studio shots on white (Alkoplaza, Metro), allowed by POLICY rule 3; both were checked against the catalogue render by pixel correlation (0.31 and 0.46, not the same file).

hunter-11: no user photo of the CURRENT label generation exists on the open web. Every otzovik and irecommend photo shows an older printing (2015-2020). The two positives are cigarpro.ru photographs of the 2023 bottle (studio on white and on a shop counter); the three variants are the 2020, 2018 and 2017 printings. The catalogue render is the 2023+ design: no year, ZNMP abbreviated, RUCHNOY SBOR set vertically on the right edge.

hunter-08: two label generations. Current, and the catalogue bottle: OVAL navy label, gold outer ring, gold griffin, ЗОЛОТАЯ БАЛКА, Брют белое in italic, and the three lines РОССИЙСКОЕ ИГРИСТОЕ ВИНО С ЗГУ КРЫМ. Earlier, and still most of the review photos: ROUND label with ЗОЛОТАЯ БАЛКА set in an arc, 1889, БРЮТ and КРЫМСКОЕ ШАМПАНСКОЕ along the bottom edge. Both share the gold КРЫМ capsule and the 1889 neck medallion, so the body label text is the only reliable test. Rejected candidates: Балаклава Reserve Brut and Гранд Капитал, which otzovik lists under the same product.

hunter-08: the discriminator between releases is the signature block. The 2021 release on the catalogue bottle carries THREE signatures (ОСМАНОВ, СИНИЦКИЙ, ВАТАМАН) with a GOLD cellar engraving. The 2022 release that cigarpro now stocks carries only TWO (ОСМАНОВ, ШПИЛЬ). Also beware of plain Массандра Саперави (otzovik product 490625), a different label entirely, and of Массандра Авторское Каберне, which bestwine24 shows under a Саперави search.

hunter-08: two label generations. Later, and the catalogue bottle: CRIMSON label, pale Chateau Andre script, pale line drawing of the chateau, MERLOT, and the year on a SEPARATE crimson band below, reading 2023. Earlier: CREAM label with a red frame, a COLOURED drawing of the chateau with a wild boar and a piglet, some printings adding WINE FACTORY under the name, and the year inside the same label, reading 2022. Beware Chateau Andre Cabernet Franc, which krymwine shows with deer instead of the boar, and the MADO line, which is a different label family.

hunter-08: all three proposals show the 2022 harvest; the catalogue bottle reads 2020. The label design is otherwise identical. No 2020 photo was found outside the catalogue render. The word РЕЗЕРВ under ШИРАЗ separates this wine from the plain Chateau de Talu Шираз, which has a different label.

hunter-08: the Уроки французского front label has THREE generations. G1: Latin CHATEAU de TALU plus the grape in Latin (CABERNET FRANC, MERLOT, CHARDONNAY). G2, which is the catalogue bottle: Latin CHATEAU de TALU plus the grape in Cyrillic (КАБЕРНЕ ФРАН). G3, current in shops and in 2024-2026 reviews: Cyrillic ШАТО де ТАЛЮ plus the grape in Cyrillic. G2 is a short transitional design, so only cru.ru still shows it for Каберне Фран. The illustration also identifies the grape: bicycles are Каберне Фран, a photographer with a tripod is Мерло, badminton is Шардоне, an easel painter is Сира.

hunter-12: three near-identical designs circulate under the name Цимлянское белое брют. The catalogue bottle is the black crossed-sabres label. Цимлянское-Ц is a white label with a large green Ц and a cartoon couple, and the pre-2022 generation is a green bottle with an ornate label headed РОССИЙСКОЕ ШАМПАНСКОЕ. I rejected the Magnit photo of Цимлянское-Ц and did not propose the alcoplaza Российское шампанское shot.

hunter-12: this wine and Цимлянское Бианка use the same tall olive bottle and the same crossed-sabres label block, and differ only in the label colour and the bottom line. Рислинг is dark navy with СУХОЕ БЕЛОЕ / РИСЛИНГ, Бианка is bright blue with ПОЛУСЛАДКОЕ БЕЛОЕ / БИАНКА. A third sister, the plain Цимлянское Сухое Белое, is medium blue and carries no grape line at all; winestyle image 209612 and vinnayagramota show that one, and I rejected both.

hunter-12: the catalogue bottle of this slug is NOT a bottle. bottle_path points at Screenshot_20_47de2b4b32.webp, a landscape photo of a winery lawn with marquees. The official page vino-svoe.ru/wines/czitronnyj-magaracha shows the same wrong picture. The wine is Табия Цитронный Магарача, a dry white of the family winery Табия (Andrey Lysov) in Gostagaevskaya, Anapa, Krasnodar Krai. Its label is white with a red chess king, ТАБИЯ at the top and Цитронный Магарача at the foot. The siblings of the line share the layout and differ only in the chess piece colour and the grape line: Буковинка purple bishop on white, Мерло yellow queen on black, and there are also Рислинг, Каберне Совиньон and Рубин Голодриги. Please replace the catalogue image.

hunter-12 trap warning: alcoplaza.ru sells this wine under the URL desono-rkatsiteli-orange-075-beloe-suhoe, but its photos photo91574 and photo91575 show the plain Desono RKATSITELI bottle, with no ORANGE line and no orange band. The producer site derbentwine.ru currently lists only Desono Rkatsiteli, not the Orange, so the Orange looks like a limited or discontinued release. The check on any candidate is the word ORANGE under RKATSITELI.

irec-01: irecommend.ru has NO page for the white Abrau Estates. Swept yandex.ru/images with site:irecommend.ru for 'Abrau Estates', 'Abrau Estates beloe suhoe', 'Abrau Esteyts Shardone Sovinon Blan', 4 result pages. The only Abrau Estates entry on irecommend is the RED one (product 2040112, review /content/abrau-estates-sukhoe-krasnoe): a BLACK label reading ABRAU ESTATES / KUBAN TERROIR / 2019 CABERNET SAUVIGNON - MERLOT / OAK AGED. The catalogue bottle here is the WHITE label 2019 CHARDONNAY - SAUVIGNON BLANC. Different wine of the same line, so nothing proposed. Note: irecommend.ru itself answers 521 from this Mac and from the VPS; images were read through the mirror cdn-irec.r-99.com.

irec-01: irecommend.ru HAS one Cuvee Alexander II review (/content/v-chest-imperatora-aleksandra-iirossiiskoe-shampanskogo-abrau-durso-cuvee-alexander-ii-brut, 6 photos), but it is a DIFFERENT bottle. Those photos show the duty-free export bottle: white oval label with ESTD 1870 and the imperial eagle, ABRAU DURSO / CUVEE ALEXANDER II / Brut / PRODUCE OF RUSSIA, a plain gold neck band, a DUTY FREE ONLY sticker, and a back label that reads 75cl 12.5% vol and FOR DUTY FREE SALES ONLY. The catalogue render is the 1.5 L Magnum: copper neck band GRAND VIN ABRAU-DURSO, a large copper crowned A-II monogram on bare glass, and a black rectangular label CUVEE ALEXANDER II / SPECIAL MILLESIME / BRUT / Tirage 3000. Neither the format nor the label generation matches, so nothing was proposed. Confidence for a variant would have been about 0.5. Open question for the owner: is the duty-free 0.75 the same cuvee under an export label?
